visualCharacteristics: Full-width 16:9 YouTube slides, edge arrows, bar dots
contentPattern: Slides carry YouTube links (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ttLUNi9sqpk, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XblaSObutgI) in the media cell instead of an image; the block JS turns them into iframes. Captions are empty in the source.

cells: YouTube link (in place of the image)

usage: Carousel of full-width 16:9 YouTube videos with edge arrows and bar indicators; iframes load lazily.
reuseGuidance: Use when several YouTube videos share one slot. For a single video use embed-video.
